1. Hearken, O ye people of my Church, saith the voice of Him who
    dwells on high, and whose eyes are upon all men; yea, verily I say,
    hearken ye people from afar; and ye that are upon the islands of
    the sea, listen together.

Hearken and hear O ye inhabitants of the earth. Listen ye ciders of my church together, and hear the voice of the Lord, for lie calleth upon all men and he commandetb all men every where to repent: for behold the Lord God hath sent forth the angel, crying through the midst of heaven, saying, Prepare
